Proficient in written and verbal communication. Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills.

review_candidates.title: Performance Technical Representative - Appalachians
review_candidates.description: Job Summary The Performance Technical Representative supports sales growth and brand awareness for KEEN’s performance product categories within assigned territories. This role focuses on building strong relationships with run specialty, outdoor specialty, and strategic retail partners through product education, in-store engagement, and community-based events. The representative delivers product training to retail staff, supports consumer-facing activations and demonstrations, and collaborates with internal teams to ensure consistent communication and effective field execution. Through regular interaction with retail partners and consumers, this role also gathers market insights and provides feedback to support ongoing brand and product development initiatives. Description Essential Functions Responsible for assigned territory, helps drive sales and grow brand awareness with specialty and strategic retail partners. Develop and maintain strong relationships with retail accounts to support brand growth by aligning product education and in-store engagement with retailer and consumer needs. Partner with Territory Managers to identify and support opportunities that strengthen brand presence and drive sell-through with retail partners. Deliver product education and training to retail staff and consumers on the features, benefits, and use cases of KEEN running, hiking, and performance sandal products. Develops in-store engagement activities that increase product awareness and maintain brand visibility within retail environments. Creates and executes new and exciting running events to drive sales and awareness growth in run specialty retailers. Represents KEEN at marketing events such as trail races, expos and trade shows both regionally and nationally. Works cross functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product and Merchandising teams to streamline communication and provide front line feedback. Maintains weekly and monthly reports on progress towards defined goals and pivots as needed with changing circumstances in the retail environment. Please note this job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without cause. Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Marketing or related field preferred. Minimum three (3) years experience in retail, sales, account marketing, or customer service (running retail experience preferred). Any equivalent combination of experience and education which clearly indicates the ability to perform the essential functions of the position may substitute on a year for year basis. Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Deep knowledge of and connection to trail running and outdoor pursuits. Genuine enthusiasm for outdoor culture and fostering the growth of the tribe. Strong presentation, public speaking, and interpersonal skills both in person and online. Self-motivated, entrepreneurial, and highly organized. Collaborative team player able to work well cross functionally and stay motivated when working alone. Proficient in Power point, Excel, Outlook, Word. Willing to travel 50% of the time. Travel Required: Yes, up to 50% of the time. MVR: Yes Base Salary: $90,000.00 - $95,000.00 This range represents the low and high ends of this position's anticipated base salary range. The actual base salary will depend on numerous factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, and location. Our base salary is just one component of our competitive total rewards strategy, which includes numerous benefits and perks as well as specific health and welfare benefits. Why Work at KEEN: Driven by a passion for life outside, KEEN is a values-led, independently owned brand from Portland, Oregon, that’s on a mission to create original and versatile products, improve lives, and inspire outside adventure. Founded in 2003, KEEN launched a revolution in the footwear industry with the introduction of the Newport adventure sandal and has donated more than $18 million to non-profit organizations and causes around the world to promote responsible outdoor recreation, including conservation efforts to protect open spaces. KEEN strives to show the world through its products and its actions that a business for good can actually be good for business. By giving back, reducing impact, and activating communities and individuals to protect the places where we work and play, KEEN puts its values in motion and takes action to leave the world a better place. Fuerst Group, KEEN, and Chrome are equal opportunity employers. We value an inclusive and diverse community. Qualified candidates of all backgrounds are encouraged to apply and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

review_candidates.title: Partnerships Manager
review_candidates.job_function: Consulting, Project Management, and General Business
review_candidates.description: Senior Associate (Partnerships Manager) — Global Supply Partnership You don't just "manage" partners. You build the supply engine that powers a global AI platform. Joveo's recruitment advertising platform runs on machine learning, real-time bidding, and predictive optimization — delivering millions of job ads to the right candidates at the right moment. But none of that works without world-class supply partnerships fueling the machine. That's where you come in. The Role — In Plain English You'll own relationships that directly impact revenue, reach, and platform performance across global markets. This isn't account management with a fancier title. You're the person who spots an untapped supply channel in Southeast Asia on Tuesday, negotiates the commercial terms by Thursday, and has it live and delivering candidates the following week. Your week might look like this: Monday: Analyze partner performance data. One channel is underpacing — you diagnose why and fix it before anyone escalates. Tuesday: Jump on a call with a new publisher. Pitch the partnership. Negotiate terms that work for both sides. Wednesday: Sit with Product and Tech to unblock an integration that's been stalling a high-value partner launch. Thursday: Build an automation workflow that eliminates 4 hours of manual reporting your team does every week. Friday: Present your partner growth roadmap to the CXO. Get buy-in. Start executing. You'll talk to partners in the morning, negotiate contracts before lunch, dig into performance dashboards after, and pitch process improvements to leadership by end of day — all in the same role. What Makes This Different Most partnership roles at this level put you in a box — either "relationship manager" or "operations associate." This one refuses to separate the two. You'll own the full lifecycle: find the partner, close the deal, launch the integration, track the numbers, optimize the outcome. End to end. No handoffs to five other teams. Direct access to CXOs and senior leadership. Real commercial ownership from day one. And you're building systems that scale — not just doing the work, but redesigning how the work gets done. You Might Be Right For This If... You have 2+ years in partnerships, supply ops, business operations, or client-facing roles — ideally in SaaS, Ad Tech, HR Tech, or recruitment advertising You've actually negotiated a deal, not just "supported" one. You know what it feels like to own a number. You're the person who looks at a messy spreadsheet and sees a pattern everyone else missed You can context-switch between a partner call, a data pull, and a strategy doc without losing momentum Process inefficiency physically bothers you. You automate things before anyone asks you to. You're comfortable in ambiguity — startup speed doesn't stress you, it sharpens you What You'll Get Real ownership: Commercial decisions, partner relationships, and operational outcomes — yours from day one Leadership exposure: Work directly with CXOs and cross-functional leads across Product, Tech, Sales, and Client Success Growth trajectory: Previous hires in this function have built entirely new capabilities within Joveo's supply ecosystem Compensation: Among the most competitive in India, including stock options Global scope: Partners and markets that span continents — not a single-geography desk job If you'd rather build the partnership playbook than follow one — we should talk. Joveo. Where AI meets the future of work.

review_candidates.description: Role: Member of Technical Staff - Robotics Lab (Remote) Location: Remote (Work from Anywhere) Job Type: Full-Time Payout: $400K - $1500K/yr Role Overview: We are hiring for one of our clients, seeking a Member of Technical Staff (Robotics Lab) to work on a full-time basis. More About the Opportunity: This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a global leader in the Information Services industry, contributing to the development of autonomous robotic systems for industrial and commercial applications.
